note.task: DATA_UPG_A literature check for 4 parameters (ASEAN energy model, EUR2020)
note.access_method: WebSearch/WebFetch for web pages and PDF reports (PDF bodies that WebFetch could not render were text-extracted locally with pypdf from the WebFetch-saved copy); GitHub history for param 3 read via the public GitHub API (gh api, read-only).
note.conversion_convention: Local currency of price year Y -> EUR at Eurostat ert_bil_eur_a annual average of Y -> EUR2020 via euro-area HICP (prc_hicp_aind CP00, 2015=100) ratio 2020/Y. 1 MMBtu = 0.29307 MWh; 1 MWh = 3.6 GJ.
note.grades: VERIFIED = read in source text; SNIPPET = search-result summary only; NOT_READ = page/PDF not reachable
note.derived_values: Fields named derived_* are computed by this agent from source numbers, not stated in the source.

entries.quote: S$ 0.95 per mmBtu, which shall be applied to a Throughput Customer’s MaxGRR
entries.conversion_chain: central = 0.95 + time-weighted utilisation 0.1224 (weekday 12h peak/4h shoulder/8h off-peak, weekend 16h shoulder/8h off-peak, 5/7-2/7) + GSC 0.04 (D10); 1.1124 SGD/MMBtu / 0.29307 = 3.7957 SGD/MWh; / 1.4756 SGD/EUR (2025 avg) = 2.5723 EUR2025/MWh; x HICP_EA 2020/2025 (105.06/128.75) = 2.0990 EUR2020/MWh; low = util 0.02, high = util 0.22. 2025 FX and 2025 HICP used as proxy for FY2026 (2026 annual data not complete).
entries.note: Throughput services = berthing/unloading, storage, regasification, send-out. Full-load assumption; lower utilisation raises per-MWh cost.
